utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday the 23rd of March. Can you all hear me, or am I doing the Teams mime again?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, you're there. Sorry, only just sat down. Traffic on the ring road was absolutely solid.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Saw that coming in. Whose new car's in the car park, then? Very shiny for this place.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Give it a day. It'll be the same colour as all the others.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Ha. Also, there's a birthday cake in the office. Before anyone asks, no, it's not mine.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: That's the important operational update covered, then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, enough. Finished stuff first, then what's actually going on the list.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I tested the Palletiser yesterday and it's all fine now. That's done, not another job for today.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Was that with it cycling properly, rather than just powered up?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, cycling. All fine. Nothing outstanding from that test.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Same sort of update from me: tested the gas turbine two yesterday and it's all fine now.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: And I finished the repair on the GT2 Number 2 Bearing last night. That one's complete.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I noticed the number two bearing was running a bit warm on nights, but it settled down.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Settled back down, yeah? You're not raising another repair there?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: No, no. Just saying what I saw. It settled down; not putting another job in.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Other thing: the shutdown on the boiler is cancelled now, production need it running.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, cancelled. That stays off the work list, then.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: And we're still waiting on parts for the line one HPU. Nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, the parts-dependent work's blocked. Not pretending that's available to do today.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Exactly. Same position as before, unfortunately.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Jamie Brennan, can you investigate the pressure drop on the Line 1 Hydraulic Power Unit on the 3rd?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Investigate, rather than take on the repair that's waiting for parts? Just keeping those separate.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, just investigate the pressure drop on the Line 1 Hydraulic Power Unit on the 3rd. Not assigning the blocked repair.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Okay, agreed. I'll investigate the pressure drop on the Line 1 Hydraulic Power Unit on the 3rd.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, that distinction matters. Otherwise it reads like the parts have magically appeared.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Olu, can you swap the filter on the compressor one today? That one's safety critical, straight away.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yep, I'll swap the filter on the compressor one today, straight away. Understood on safety critical.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, that's not one to bury underneath the routine stuff.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: No, understood. Immediate one for me.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: While we're on the compressor one, it still needs someone to take vibration readings. Low priority, though, separate from the filter.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Anyone actually taking the vibration readings, or is that still without a name?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: I'm taking the filter, not the readings. Don't put both against me.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, vibration readings on the compressor one stay unassigned. Low priority, no owner.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I'll replace the seals on the water booster first thing tomorrow. That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Tomasz. Water booster seals, first thing tomorrow, first job because it's holding production up.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, that's mine. First thing tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Sorry, talking over you—first tomorrow, not shifting the safety-critical filter out of the way today?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct. Different timing. Today's filter is straight away; seals first thing tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Jamie, can you do a site visit at the water works with the contractor Monday?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Monday as in today, yeah? Not next week?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, today, Monday. The site visit at the water works with the contractor.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Right, accepted. I'll do a site visit at the water works with the contractor Monday.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Out of stores and into the fresh air. Luxury.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Your definition of luxury and mine are miles apart.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: There's also ordering spare parts for the main conveyor. That needs doing tomorrow at 9:30, but there's no name against it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. Anyone able to take ordering those spare parts for the main conveyor?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I can't take that one. Don't assume it's mine just because it says parts.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I'm not taking it either. Just to be clear.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, nobody's taken it. Order spare parts for the main conveyor, tomorrow at 9:30, still unassigned.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: So that's outstanding, not an order that's already gone through?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Correct, outstanding. No order placed and no owner agreed.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: On the planning side, I'll schedule downtime for the line three with production by Wednesday. That's in the 'whenever you get a chance' category, not an urgent one.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Okay, Sarah. Whenever you get a chance, but still by Wednesday for getting it scheduled?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, exactly. I'll have it scheduled by Wednesday. Lower urgency, same deadline.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And the shift handover report going round—is that covered?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll send the shift handover report round by Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Cheers, Saz. That's clear.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. And the two things without names really are without names. Silence isn't somebody volunteering.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Fine by me. And just keeping the cancelled boiler shutdown separate from all that. It's not pending.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Same with the parts wait I mentioned: blocked work, not a fresh commitment.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep. That's the distinction. Anything else that's just a correction to what we've said?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: No correction. Only concern is whether that cake survives this call.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: On Teams? You can practically hear people cutting it in the background.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, we're done. Thanks, everyone.
